test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the ANTONYM of the word ‘combative’ from the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Agreeable'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** 'Combative' **means eager to fight or argue. **(जुझारू)****​**

 
 
• **​Example- **The prime minister was in a **combative **mood, twice accusing the opposition of gross incompetence. 
 
 
 
• **'Agreeable'** means ready to agree **(राज़ी, सहमत; सहमत होने के लिए तैयार)**
 
 
• **​Example- **All the members were **agreeable **to the decision made in the meeting.
 
 
 
• In the passage, the word 'combative' is used to describe the nature of debates and discussions that took place within the Constituent Assembly. 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 2'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Secular** refers to the principle of separating religion from government affairs. **(धर्मनिरपेक्ष)**
 
• **Contentious **means likely to cause an argument. **(विवादग्रस्‍त, विवादास्‍पद)**
 
• **Legacy** refers to something handed down from the past. **(परंपरा)**
